sections.title: What we run
sections.body: One project owner from brief to packed shipment.
items: Development — Confirm construction and material options from your spec or a reference sample.
Sampling — You review samples before bulk.
Bulk — Confirmed specs go to production with in-process checks.
Packing — Labels, inner packs, and export cartons to your brief.

sections.title: Buying FAQ
sections.body: We aim to respond to inquiries within one business day.
items: What do you need for a first quote? — Product references, estimated quantity, destination market, and any logo or packing notes.
Do you support OEM programs? — Yes—produce from your spec, or develop with our sampling team.
How do sampling and bulk timing work? — Sample timing depends on construction; bulk starts after sample approval and material confirmation.
How fast do you reply? — We aim to respond to inquiries within one business day.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: [Brand] uses the contact details you submit to reply to quotes and project briefs. We do not sell enquiry data. To update or delete information, write to [Email].

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.content: Content on this website is for product information and enquiry. Specifications and lead times are confirmed in writing on each quotation. Nothing here is a binding offer. Commercial terms sit on documents issued by [Legal Name].
